ceu: ✦ The square between Mars and Uranus

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
From {H:1796241834000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between routine and conversations. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
From {H:1796241834000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between romance and money. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
From {H:1796241834000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between family and your image. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
From {H:1796241834000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
From {H:1796241834000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between money and friendships. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
From {H:1796241834000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between your image and your career. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Start something new today, however small.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
From {H:1796241834000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Spend five minutes in silence before going to sleep.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
From {H:1796241834000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Write down a dream and three steps to get there.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
From {H:1796241834000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between your career and relationships. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Set aside an hour without interruptions for what matters most.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
From {H:1796241834000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Teach someone something you know well.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
From {H:1796241834000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between intimacy and romance. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Review debts, loans or shared accounts calmly.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
From {H:1796241834000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between relationships and family. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Thank someone who supports you and rarely hears a thank-you.
